name: ckanext-csvwmapandtransform
purpose: After an RDF/JSON-LD resource is created or updated in CKAN, automatically discovers YAML mapping files stored in a CKAN group named 'mappings', tests each against the resource via RDFConverter /api/checkmapping, selects the best-fit mapping, and calls RDFConverter /api/createrdf to produce a joined Turtle RDF knowledge graph — which is added back to the same CKAN dataset.
trigger_conditions: resource URL does NOT contain '-joined' (prevents recursive re-processing)

mapping_discovery.collects: Every resource with format == YAML from packages in the mappings group
mapping_discovery.prerequisite: A CKAN group named exactly 'mappings' must exist

mapping_selection.mechanism: For each YAML mapping URL: POST {rdfconverter_url}/api/checkmapping → {rules_applicable, rules_skipped} → rating = rules_applicable - rules_skipped

strategies.name: exact
strategies.risk: May produce no output if no exact mapping exists

strategies.name: best_match
strategies.use_when: Development / exploration — best partial match applies
strategies.risk: May apply an imperfect mapping, producing partial graphs

rdf_conversion.output: Turtle file uploaded as new resource in same CKAN dataset; filename contains '-joined'

registered_actions.purpose: Test all mappings against a resource

configuration.description: MapToMethod URL — used in browser iframes for mapping authoring UI
RDFConverter URL (use internal container URL in DataStack)

configuration.default: json json-ld turtle n3 nt hext trig longturtle xml ld+json

configuration.description: CKAN API token for background job authentication
Database URL for job state tracking

capabilities: Fully automatic — no user action needed after CSV upload (if mappings exist)
Scales to many mappings — checks all YAML resources in the mappings group
Two selection strategies for different accuracy/coverage tradeoffs
limitations: Requires a 'mappings' CKAN group (case-sensitive) with YAML resources
Data URL must be publicly accessible from the CKAN server
exact strategy may silently produce no output if no mapping fully matches
RDFConverter timeouts may need tuning for large files (default: 120s)
BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN must be set or jobs will not execute
